parsed.title: Custom Bestie Slot Unlock on Signup Decline
parsed.oneLiner: Offer guest users a single Custom Bestie creation slot after they dismiss the signup sheet.
parsed.trigger: When a guest user taps 'Close sheet' on the Custom Bestie signup sheet without signing up.
parsed.eligibility: Guest users without an account who decline the signup prompt on the Custom Bestie sheet.

offer.title: Create One Custom Bestie
offer.body: Play a 15-second mini-game to unlock one Custom Bestie slot without an account. Customize your AI companion immediately.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Surfaced strictly after the user declines the full signup sheet (m8), ensuring users with intent to sign up do so first [TAX-10]. Sized to a single creation slot, leaving multi-persona management, cloud backup, and Luzia+ features gated [CANN-1, AI-8].

kpis.primary: Custom Bestie creations by guest users
guardrails: Account signup conversion rate non-inferiority (-2% relative)
kpis.holdout: User-level 10% holdout of guest users declining Custom Bestie signup for 28 days

risks: Guest users might lose their custom bestie if local storage is cleared before creating an account.
Slight risk of delaying immediate account signup for users satisfied with a single custom persona.

evidence.quote: Sign up to personalize your Bestie's look, personality and interests.
Make an AI expert tailored to you

newScreens.change: Fallback offer sheet shown upon tapping close on s02, offering a single guest custom bestie slot in exchange for playing a mini-game.

newElements.change: Simula MiniGameInvitation card with title 'Create One Custom Bestie', Luzia Game Partner avatar, play CTA, and 'No thanks' decline button.
